name: trove-visual-parity
description: Achieve pixel-exact UI equivalence between two implementations via image diff. Establish a baseline harness first, migrate one component at a time, verify each with a screenshot diff within a tuned threshold. Use when migrating a styling system or matching a new implementation (e.g. React) to an existing one (e.g. Vue). Use when: match this design exactly; visual parity; pixel-perfect migration.
